# Foremost

`foremost` &middot; _forensics_

Carves files out of a disk image or binary by their headers and footers.

**Low impact.** Reading public information or local files.

## What this tool needs

- An image or binary file inside the evidence folder.

## How to use it

Give it a filename. Foremost recovers files (images, documents, archives) it can recognise inside the image. The recovered files land in an output folder you can open.

## Examples

```console
$ foremost -i image.raw -o out
```

## At a glance

- Category: `forensics`
- Install with: `apt install foremost`
- Baseline: yes
- Licence: Public domain (US Air Force)
- Upstream: <https://foremost.sourceforge.net/>
